name: Extract Vitality
description:
Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against a creature within short range. On a win, it takes 1d4 damage and you regain that amount of Endurance. On a loss, it takes 1 damage and you regain 1 Endurance.

Either way, check a Condition.

Describe how you extract and imbibe their energy.
successes:
✨: Roll an additional d4.

🌞: They instead take HEART damage and you regain HEART Endurance.

💀: Check an additional condition.
